description: The file is an HTML document that implements the frontend interface for a database visualizer web application. It contains structure, style, and scripts for browsing databases, tables, and viewing data in a table format with interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by reloading data and resetting UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data from a selected table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data into an HTML table with interactive cell expansion.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for objects or long strings.

search-terms: UI for browsing databases and tables
